issue_comments.body: I'm confused, you want to write `omega0` and `aleph0` and also `omega_one` and `alepg_one`? I'm virtually certain that if you asked on Zulip, the poll would go in favor of `omega_zero` too and `aleph_zero` too (at least, assuming votes from the same people).

`omega0` (a def for the order type of ℕ) is different from `omega_zero` (the omega function evaluated at zero). We even have [`Ordinal.omega_zero`](https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/Mathlib/SetTheory/Cardinal/Aleph.html#Ordinal.omega_zero) as a simp lemma converting between these.
Oh I see! Then I think the asymmetry in that lemma is actually very important! It actually indicates something meaningful about the difference between them.
